test_cli_init: test the wgit cli init command to create a new checkpoint version control repository
test_cli_add: test the wgit cli add command to stage a PyTorch checkpoint file for commit
test_cli_commit: test the wgit cli commit command to commit staged checkpoint changes with a message
test_cli_status: test the wgit cli status command to check the cleanliness of tracked checkpoint files
test_cli_log: test the wgit cli log command to display the commit history of the repository
